DROP TABLE Fine;

SET LINESIZE 200;
SET PAGESIZE 200;
SET DEFINE OFF;

COLUMN fineID       FORMAT A8;
COLUMN fineAmt      FORMAT 9999.99;
COLUMN fineStatus   FORMAT A13;
COLUMN paymentDate  FORMAT A12;
COLUMN paymentType  FORMAT A15;
COLUMN loanID       FORMAT A8;
COLUMN copyID       FORMAT A8;

CREATE TABLE Fine (
    fineID        VARCHAR2(6) NOT NULL,
    fineAmt       NUMBER(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    fineStatus    VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    paymentDate   DATE,
    paymentType   VARCHAR2(50),
    loanID        VARCHAR2(8) NOT NULL,  -- changed from 6 to 8
    copyID        VARCHAR2(6) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fineID),
    FOREIGN KEY (loanID, copyID) REFERENCES Loan_Details(loanID, copyID),
    CONSTRAINT chk_fineID_format CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(fineID, '^F[0-9]{5}$'))
);
